content: Employees can reset their password through the company self-service portal. Passwords must contain at least 12 characters.
Employees must connect using the company VPN client. If VPN connectivity fails, restart the client and verify internet connectivity. Contact IT if the issue continues.
Laptop hardware problems should be reported to IT support. Include the device ID and a description of the issue.
Employees must request software installation through the IT helpdesk. Administrator approval may be required.
Employees can access company email through the corporate email portal. If access fails, check network connectivity and account status.
Check that the printer is powered on, connected to the network, and has sufficient paper. Restart the printer if necessary. Contact IT support if the issue continues.
